description: Angular service class 'AiModelsTableConfigResolver' configuring an entity table for AI models, including columns, actions, and dialog interactions.

classes.name: AiModelsTableConfigResolver
classes.description: Angular injectable service that provides configuration for AI models table, including columns, actions, and dialog handling.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Returns the configured EntityTableConfig for AI models.

methods.name: configureCellActions
methods.description: Sets up cell action descriptors, such as edit action.

methods.name: editModel
methods.description: Opens dialog to edit an existing AI model and updates data upon completion.

methods.name: addModel
methods.description: Opens dialog to add a new AI model and returns an observable of the created model.
